info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v2-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupons API allows users to fetch a list of available coupons applicable to their shopping cart. This functionality supports businesses seeking to enhance customer satisfaction by offering discounts and promotional offers. Developers can integrate this API to retrieve coupon information, enabling them to display relevant savings to users at checkout. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and pricing management systems aiming to optimize the shopping experience through targeted promotions.

get.summary: Retrieve the current coupon status in the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of any coupons applied to the shopping cart. It provides information about active and expired coupons, including potential discounts and promotional offers. Use this to check whether any discounts can be applied to the user's current cart items.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send coupon information to the cart endpoint for validation or application of discounts. The JSON object must conform to the defined schema.

ListEcommerceCartCouponsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation related to coupons in the cart.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the coupon operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the coupon operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the coupon operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the result.

ListEcommerceCartCouponsResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving coupon operation details.

createdBy.description: The user who created the coupon.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the coupon was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the coupon creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit details of the coupon operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
